additional_info.subject: Notes from customer
additional_info.body:
The weight and charging cable 1 is too long without its cable management and is dragging on the ground.
This solution was implemented by the Siemens France teams to quickly meet our needs during the issues with melted poles in the connectors.
Could you please replace it with a cable of appropriate length?
Vehicles are driving over the cable.
Thanks.
